evidence: numerical-uncalibrated simulation with harmonised criteria (sim/js/concepts/common/criteria.js); demo is an engineering illustration; nothing physically tested

params.note: v2: faired airframe, swappable packs, capture cone; v3: + vision fallback, forward depth sensor (avoid/yield), leapfrog/pan
≤150 g keeps KE ≤14.9 J up to ~14 m/s; airframe scaled from 245 g
warm inner pocket; swapped on the lift
tow leash: 20 m Dyneema, braked reel holds the drag tension

modelLimits: No onboard vision avoidance: only the track corridor; branches above head height and off-corridor obstacles are invisible to it
Quasi-static momentum-theory rotors; no thrust loss at high advance ratio, vortex ring or ground effect
Attitude as a first-order thrust-vector lag, no rotational inertia/yaw dynamics; rider wake is a simplified turbulence add-on
Footage is geometric only (no exposure, snow glare, motion blur, occlusion); noise is assumed
Pod capture is a geometric criterion (radius + relative speed), no contact mechanics or lid mechanism
Trees are deterministic cone + branch envelopes; real tree lines are irregular and sway
Regulation only flagged (VLOS / resort permission); no legal analysis
v2 airframe scaled by mass (no CFD/wind tunnel); fairing drag area ASSUMED; EPP shroud not credited (ASTM F3389 test pending)
Pod downwash recirculation is an assumed random lateral force (5 % W); tow leash: geometry and tension only, no tangling/snag dynamics
Endurance extrapolated from 20–36 s runs; packs start at the pocket/pod temperature
v3 vision tracker and depth sensor are parametric ASSUMPTIONS (detection vs distance/light, noise, FOV), not fitted to real datasets; trees sensed as cone envelopes, no thin twigs or snow-fog
Beacon on the torso strap: shared trunk.js trunk rotation not yet applied (beacon point follows the whole-body lean of bodyPoints)

modes: 7.605: Mode leap → follow: rider has passed; rejoin the corridor

stages.en: The 150 g faired drone sits in the pod on top of the pack. The rider takes a warm pack from the inner pocket and swaps it in (normally done on the lift; illustration). Beacon and button are on the strap.
One tap on the strap button: the lid flips up behind the head and the drone climbs vertically to 3 m above the snow, then backs off.

Before push-off the drone waits ahead and beside the line, 4 m up; as the rider passes the gimbal pans front → side → rear, then the drone rejoins the corridor behind. Used automatically when the rider exceeds the KE-safe speed.

The drone replays the track about 0.5 s behind and 3 m up; at about 21 s the forward depth sensor sees a branch above head height and the drone ducks to 2 m, inside the corridor the rider just passed under.
On a segment flagged as open snow the drone leaves the track for a side tracking pass, then rejoins it. Off-track it loses the verified-corridor guarantee.
The rider stops hard: the braking governor halts the drone ≥3 m away, with no overrun and never overhead.
At the stop the drone flies one 5 m-radius orbit for an all-round shot.
The drone moves above the pod, stops at 0.25 m to align on the optical marker, then commits quickly through the recirculating downwash into the 10 cm capture cone; the lid closes to keep it warm.
